description: Generic, product-wide UI/UX suite run by the browser tester on every full verification pass against every distinct screen. Derived from docs/ui-visual-verification.md and skills/ui-ux-testing/SKILL.md. P0/P1 cases block BROWSER_TEST_PASS; P2/P3 cases are advisory and logged as UX-* defects.

cases.title: Persistent navigation surface and home link on authenticated screens
steps: Load each distinct authenticated screen exercised in this run
Look for a persistent nav surface (sidebar or topnav)
Look for a visible, functional home/dashboard link
cases.expected: Every authenticated screen shows a persistent nav surface and a working home/dashboard link

cases.title: Back-to-home reachable without browser back button
cases.appliesTo: every screen including detail, modal, and outcome pages
steps: From each screen (including detail views and outcome pages), locate a clickable path back to home
Confirm it is a nav logo, breadcrumb first segment, or explicit home nav item
cases.expected: Every screen offers at least one in-app path back to home — no browser-back-only dead ends

cases.title: No forbidden nav items visible to the current role
cases.appliesTo: every authenticated screen for each role
steps: Inspect nav chrome (sidebar, topnav, breadcrumbs, inline links)
Confirm there are no links to routes the current role cannot access
Confirm forbidden items are absent, not merely disabled
cases.expected: Nav chrome contains zero links to forbidden routes; none are rendered as disabled

cases.title: Forbidden route renders a styled access-denied page
preconditions: Authenticated as a role lacking access to a known privileged route
steps: Navigate directly to a forbidden route via URL
Observe the rendered result
cases.expected: A styled access-denied page renders (not a crash, blank screen, or login redirect), explains the restriction in plain language, and includes a home link

cases.title: Login page neutrality and correct post-login redirect
steps: Open the login page and read its heading and copy
Authenticate as each available role
Observe the post-login landing route
cases.expected: Login page has no role-specific copy; after login each role lands on its correct home page, not a generic shell or the wrong dashboard

cases.title: No internal identifiers or codes in user-facing text
steps: Scan visible UI text on each screen — headings, labels, table columns, toasts, empty states
Look for technical IDs, schema field names, requirement codes, or internal slugs
cases.expected: No internal identifiers (e.g. item_id, AC-01, slice slugs) appear in user-facing text

cases.title: Primary, danger, and disabled controls meet contrast and legibility
steps: Screenshot each screen with primary, danger, and disabled controls
Verify primary CTA foreground on primary background is legible (not washed out)
Verify danger actions use inverse text; disabled labels remain legible (>= 3:1)
cases.expected: Primary and danger controls meet the documented contrast pair; disabled controls read as disabled while staying legible

cases.title: Responsive layout at 320px width has no overflow or clipping
cases.appliesTo: every screen when the product serves mobile form factors
steps: Load each distinct screen at 320px width
Check for horizontal scroll, clipped content, or off-screen controls
cases.expected: Content reflows within 320px width — no horizontal scroll, clipping, or below-fold primary actions

cases.title: Visible focus states and keyboard operability
steps: Tab through interactive elements on each screen
Confirm a visible focus indicator on each focusable control
Confirm primary actions are reachable and operable via keyboard
cases.expected: Interactive elements show a visible focus ring and are keyboard operable

cases.title: Loading honesty — no infinite spinner or premature success
cases.appliesTo: every screen with async data or submissions
steps: Trigger data loads and form submissions on each relevant screen
Observe spinner, layout stability, and success timing
cases.expected: Loading states resolve without infinite spinners or layout shift; success is shown only after the server confirms

cases.title: Outcome states are visually differentiated
steps: Exercise success, warning, error, and empty states where reachable
Compare their alert/badge styling
cases.expected: Success, warning, error, empty, and forbidden states use visually distinct surfaces — not identical styling

cases.title: Form fields have labels and inline validation feedback
preconditions: Authenticated as any role with access to a form
steps: Open each form and confirm every field has a visible label
Submit invalid input and observe where errors surface
Confirm submit/disabled feedback is visible in the UI
cases.expected: Every field is labeled; validation errors surface inline in the UI (not only console/toast); submit state is clear

cases.title: Touch targets are large enough on mobile
cases.appliesTo: every interactive control on mobile viewports
steps: Measure interactive controls (buttons, icon nav, links) on mobile
Confirm hit area is at least 44x44px
cases.expected: Interactive controls meet a 44x44px minimum touch target on mobile

cases.title: Spacing rhythm and typography hierarchy are not cramped
steps: Screenshot each screen and review padding on cards, tables, and buttons
Review title/body/metadata hierarchy and heading clipping
cases.expected: Content has comfortable, token-aligned spacing; typography hierarchy is clear with no clipped headings
